name: Quicken Stride
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 0, druid 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The recipient of this spell receives a five foot enhancement bonus to its base land speed. The spell does not enhance any other mode of travel (swimming, flying, burrowing, etc.).
